name: Keko & the NightShard
description:
About This Game

The night sky shattered. The world cracked open. And somewhere in the wreckage of a floating continent, a reckless pirate cat touched something in a box he absolutely should not have touched.

Now Keko and the Nightshard, a living fragment of the broken sky, one body, one mission, and no idea what they're doing. Merged together, they are something neither of them expected: unstoppable, cosmic, and just barely in control.

But the sky doesn't fix itself. Six corrupted rulers have claimed the wreckage of the floating world for their own. And above them all, at the highest point of a broken continent, something hollow and ancient is waiting, a villain who wants back what Keko now carries.

Glide between floating islands. Split apart when the world demands cooperation. Fight your way up through a shattered civilization full of secrets, mystery, and moments that will stay with you long after the credits roll.

Somewhere in the darkness, a voice is asking for help.

Find out whose.

Features

  • Dual-Character Gameplay
    Control Keko and the Night Shard and use their different abilities together to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and interact with the world.

  • Creative Platforming & Puzzles
    Combine movement, positioning, timing, environmental interaction, and both characters' abilities to overcome varied challenges.

  • Constant Mechanical Variety
    Discover new character abilities and environmental mechanics as you travel between islands, with new gameplay ideas building on what you have already learned.

  • Explore a Shattered World
    Travel across atmospheric islands, unlock new areas, and gradually restore the world as you recover the missing Night Shards.
short_desc: a 3D-Platformer adventure where you control two interconnected characters: Keko, a pirate cat, and the Night Shard, a living fragment of the shattered night sky. Explore mysterious islands, overcome challenges, and restore the broken night sky.
